title: SK会长称海力士美国上市是“梦想成真”
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think a sensible place to start is why now you've been thinking about a US listing for some time but why put SK Hynex in front of US investors now?
segments.zh: 我想从为什么现在开始说起，您考虑美国上市已有一段时间，为何现在将SK海力士推向美国市场参与者？

segments.en: Well we've been waiting for that for a long long time and since I acquired that Hynex about 15 years ago.
segments.zh: 我们等待这一刻已经很久了，自从大约15年前我收购海力士以来。

segments.en: So this is one of our milestones. Well we have to go to access to the US capital market.
segments.zh: 所以这是我们的一个里程碑。我们必须进入美国资本市场。

segments.en: So people asking why now but well this is kind of the earliest moment we can have.
segments.zh: 有人问为什么是现在，但这是我们能实现的最早时机。

segments.en: The earliest moment possible. 26.5 billion dollars is a lot of money.
But in the context of SK's commitment in domestically and career and internationally not so big
segments.zh: 但考虑到SK在国内和国际的承诺，这个数字并不算大。

segments.en: can we expect multiple returns to ADRs, the sale of multiple rounds of ADRs?
segments.zh: 我们能否期待多次ADR发行？

segments.en: Well yes I'm expect we can deliver those things too.
segments.zh: 是的，我期待我们也能做到这些。

segments.en: So try to expand that our ADR size and also battery.
segments.zh: 所以我们会努力扩大ADR规模，也包括电池业务。

segments.en: That actually requires a battery tons. Once we have the battery tons then there is a more demand.
segments.zh: 这实际上需要大量的电池。一旦我们有了足够的电池，需求就会更大。
